verses.text: For the choirmaster. Of David. The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt; their acts are vile. There is no one who does good.

xrefs.text: In his pride the wicked man does not seek Him; in all his schemes there is no God.
For the choirmaster. According to Mahalath. A Maskil of David. The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt; their ways are vile. There is no one who does good.
As it is written: “There is no one righteous, not even one.
For although they knew God, they neither glorified Him as God nor gave thanks to Him, but they became futile in their thinking and darkened in their foolish hearts.
A senseless man does not know, and a fool does not understand,

verses.text: The LORD looks down from heaven upon the sons of men to see if any understand, if any seek God.

xrefs.text: There is no one who understands, no one who seeks God.
The LORD looks down from heaven; He sees all the sons of men.
And without faith it is impossible to please God. For anyone who approaches Him must believe that He exists and that He rewards those who earnestly seek Him.
For He looked down from the heights of His sanctuary; the LORD gazed out from heaven to earth
And God looked upon the earth and saw that it was corrupt; for all living creatures on the earth had corrupted their ways.

verses.text: All have turned away, they have together become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.

xrefs.text: As it is written: “There is no one righteous, not even one.
We all like sheep have gone astray, each one has turned to his own way; and the LORD has laid upon Him the iniquity of us all.
Each of us has become like something unclean, and all our righteous acts are like filthy rags; we all wither like a leaf, and our iniquities carry us away like the wind.
for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God,
For the choirmaster. Of David. The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt; their acts are vile. There is no one who does good.

verses.text: Will the workers of iniquity never learn? They devour my people like bread; they refuse to call upon the LORD.

xrefs.text: Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge You, on the kingdoms that refuse to call on Your name,

Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge You, and on the families that do not call on Your name. For they have devoured Jacob; they have consumed him and finished him off; they have devastated his homeland.
They do not know or understand; they wander in the darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.
No one calls on Your name or strives to take hold of You. For You have hidden Your face from us and delivered us into the hand of our iniquity.
Furthermore, since they did not see fit to acknowledge God, He gave them up to a depraved mind, to do what ought not to be done.

verses.text: There they are, overwhelmed with dread, for God is in the company of the righteous.

xrefs.text: His descendants will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
If I had said, “I will speak this way,” then I would have betrayed Your children.
Such is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek Your face, O God of Jacob. Selah
But now, this is what the LORD says— He who created you, O Jacob, and He who formed you, O Israel: “Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by your name; you are Mine!
God is within her; she will not be moved. God will help her when morning dawns.

verses.text: You sinners frustrate the plans of the oppressed, yet the LORD is their shelter.

xrefs.text: The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.
Like the crushing of my bones, my enemies taunt me, while they say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”
How long, O men, will my honor be maligned? How long will you love vanity and seek after lies Selah
and saying, “You who are going to destroy the temple and rebuild it in three days, save Yourself! If You are the Son of God, come down from the cross!
“Give this message to Hezekiah king of Judah: ‘Do not let your God, in whom you trust, deceive you by saying that Jerusalem will not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

verses.text: Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion! When the LORD restores His captive people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad!

xrefs.text: Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion! When God restores His captive people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad!
For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. You showed favor to Your land, O LORD; You restored Jacob from captivity.
